name: The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind
summary: A holy symbol of great power against the undead, lost long ago in the valley.

stages.journal: Madam Eva's second card spoke of a power of light and faith: a sunburst with a raven at its heart, made to hold vampires still. She saw where it lies. {tarokka.symbol.hint}
objectives: Find the Holy Symbol of Ravenkind

stages.journal: We have the Holy Symbol of Ravenkind. It is warm to the touch, even here.
